title: UI graph
description: facts.ui in asbuilt/facts.json: the controls of each screen named in designc.json ui.screens, read from source with the TypeScript compiler (extract/ui.js). Display only: never a gate input, finding, DSL line or fingerprint input. Nothing is guessed: what the source cannot show is null and listed in unresolved. docs/ui-graph.example.json is the fixture output, pinned in test/extract-ui.test.js.

lib.description: Decided by the call's shape and, for date-fns, dayjs and moment, by the file's own import of that package.

call.description: Intl.<X>Format, toLocaleDateString, toLocaleTimeString, toLocaleString, or format.

pattern.description: date-fns: the literal second argument; dayjs/moment: the literal first argument; Intl and toLocale*: the argument source text when every argument is a literal. Null otherwise; never evaluated.

args.description: Source text of the arguments, whitespace squashed.

rule.description: type (the zod/yup base: string, number, ...), then each chained call (min, max, regex, optional, ...), or a react-hook-form rule (required, maxLength, pattern, validate, ...).

value.description: A literal number, string, boolean or regex source; true for a call with no argument or required: 'message'; otherwise source text.

message.description: A react-hook-form rule's message, when literal.

screen.description: Absent for problems that concern no one screen (tsconfig, compiler).

repo.description: Which repository: codebase, or a designc.json references key (later, 7e).

roots.description: Repo-relative source files the screen's patterns match, sorted.

components.description: Component ids declared in the roots.

followed.description: Component ids outside the roots that a root renders and that were followed (in-repo source, not a library's .d.ts), sorted.

name.description: The capitalised function, arrow const or class; a default export with no name, or JSX outside any component, takes the module name (file, or folder for index).

renders.description: Capitalised JSX tags it renders, sorted (declared components only; a followed one has an empty list).

basis.description: declared: in a root file. followed: outside the roots, read because a root renders it.

id.description: <screen>:<file>:<line>:<column>, and for a followed control the usage chain: <screen>:<usage file>:<l>:<c>>...><file>:<l>:<c>

tag.description: The intrinsic element, or for an unfollowed component (library or unresolved) its name.

as.description: For a control inside a followed component: the component name used at the outermost usage site (file and line are that site).

via.description: The followed components from the usage site to the element, outermost first.

at.description: Where the element itself is, when it sits in a followed component.

library.description: The package an unfollowed component comes from; its role is not in source.

role.description: Null when the source cannot show it; an unresolved entry says why.

basis.description: native: the HTML element's implicit role. aria: a literal role attribute. followed: the role of an element inside a followed component. mapped: from designc.json ui.roles (7e, not yet). Null for a library or unresolved component.

name.description: The accessible name when a literal decides it: the first source present in the order aria-labelledby, aria-label, label, alt, text, value, title, placeholder. Null when that source is an expression or t('key').

value.description: Literal text, the i18n key for t(), or null for an expression.

expr.description: Source text of the expression when value is null.

spreads.description: How many {...props} spreads the element has whose attributes could not be read (a spread of a followed component's props is read).

when.description: The conditions under which the control is rendered, outermost first (the usage chain of a followed component, then its own), never evaluated. Absent when always rendered.

kind.description: and: c && <x/>. or: c || <x/> (expr !(c)). ternary: c ? <x/> : y (else branch !(c)). if: if (c) { return <x/> } (else !(c)). if-return: an earlier if (c) return ...; (expr !(c)).

props.description: State props the element carries (or its aria- form). true for a bare or literal attribute; source text for an expression; absent when false or not given.

format.description: The first formatting call inside the element (its text or attributes). Absent when there is none.

field.description: A react-hook-form register(name, rules) spread on the element. Absent when there is none.

form.description: The one zod or yup schema on the screen that names the field; null when none does, or several do (then an unresolved entry).

name.description: Null when the name is not a literal.

expr.description: Source text of the name when not a literal.

rules.description: The schema's rules for the field, then the register rules.

formats.description: Every formatting call in the screen's components (declared and followed, each file once), sorted by screen, file, line. Includes calls outside controls, such as a date in a table cell.

forms.description: zod z.object({...}) and yup yup.object({...}) / yup.object().shape({...}) schemas assigned to a const in the screen's files, sorted by screen, file, line.

rules.description: Empty when the value is not a chain.
